label: Blind sample 001: Hansen forest loss 2020, tile 60N_100E

verdict.headline: Real change
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.14 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2020 (90% interval −0.15 to −0.12). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 0 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.02). Counted by gap size instead, 0 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.02).

evidence.sentence: Optical shows the change (greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.14); radar is inconclusive (radar backscatter (VH) −0.9 dB, interval −1.2 to −0.1).
